title: Business Combinations–Classification either as Acquisitions or Unitings of Interests
summary: Addressed how to classify a business combination as an acquisition or a uniting of interests (pooling of interests). Superseded in 2004 by IFRS 3.

related.title: Business Combinations
related.relationship: The standard that entirely superseded SIC-9 in 2004 by abolishing the uniting-of-interests method and requiring acquisition method for all business combinations
